description: Stationnement payant sur voirie is a dataset listed in Open Data Hauts-de-Seine, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Clichy. Référentiel détaillant individuellement l'emplacement des places de stationnement existantes et payantes sur la voirie publique à Clichy. Coverage: Hauts-de-Seine. The portal files it under Transport / Mobilité. Its keywords are parking, Stationnements, voirie. The portal shows 5,139 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-03-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-hauts-de-seine-fr-portal.
